newsitem.title: INDIA: Fire in Delhi cinema hall; several trapped.
newsitem.headline: Fire in Delhi cinema hall; several trapped.

text.p: Fire broke out in a crowded New Delhi cinema hall on Friday and many people were feared trapped inside, fire and police officials said.
A police spokesman said many people were injured and rescuers were dragging victims out of the cinema hall.
It was not immediately clear what had triggered the fire.
Last week at least 40 pilgrims died in a huge blaze in a temple complex in the south Indian state of Tamil Nadu.
